source: BNBC 1993 / 2006 Part 6: the structure importance coefficient CI of wind (Table 6.2.9) and the structure importance factor I of earthquake (Table 6.2.23) by the occupancy categories of Table 6.1.1, in SAEngine's four slots (I low risk, II standard, III special occupancy, IV essential and hazardous).
